global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, dark broth with tender chashu pork and crisp menma arranged atop the noodles. The white bowl, adorned with red characters, sits on a black tray under soft, natural light.

regions.background: Black tray with red rim, textured surface, rectangular shape, visible wood grain pattern on adjacent table.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red "吉" characters and green dragon pattern on rim, glossy surface.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and contains submerged noodles and green scallions.
regions.spoon: White ceramic spoon with smooth, slightly glossy surface and subtle textured pattern on its bowl.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows browned, fatty texture with glossy surface and irregular shape.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear light brown, glossy, with segmented, slightly curved shapes and visible fibrous texture.
